sources.entry: TextCraft - Add-in for Microsoft Word that seamlessly integrates essential AI tools, including text generation, proofreading, and more, directly into the user interface.

summary.one_liner: TextCraft is a Windows Microsoft Word add-in that brings AI text generation, writing review, proofreading, rewriting, and document-aware comment replies into Word, with support for local Ollama models and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
use_cases: Drafting text inside Word with a local model
Getting writing feedback on a document
Asking an AI questions via Word comment mentions
Adding PDF reference material to inform AI output
Using a private, offline AI writing assistant in Word
how_to_run: Download TextCraft_x64.zip (or TextCraft_x32.zip) and extract it
Run OfficeAddInSetup.msi, then open Microsoft Word
notable: Works offline with Ollama models, aiming for privacy
Works with any OpenAI-compatible API endpoint such as OpenAI, Ollama, or vLLM
RAG context from user-added PDFs used by Generate, Review, and Comment
Mention the AI by model name in a Word comment to get an in-document reply
Environment variables let you override system prompts and endpoint settings
caveats: Windows only: requires Windows 10 version 20H2 or later and Microsoft Office 2010 or later
Requires installing Ollama and pulling models separately for the default local setup
Development build from source auto-installs the add-in into Word; cleaning the project is needed to remove it
Other providers are only 'generally supported' and need checking against their docs
